question.:question/problem:
Which diagram represents

$$
\mathbf F(x,y)=\left(y+2\right)\,i+\left(x-2\right)\,j
$$

at $A=(1,3)$, $B=(-1,-2)$, $C=(-1,3)$? All diagrams use one unit per grid interval.

Evaluate both components at each point, then place the tail of its vector at that point.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Write $\mathbf F=P\,i+Q\,j$. Substitute into each component, then combine the results:

$$
\begin{aligned}
P(1,3)&=(3)-(-2)=5 \\
Q(1,3)&=(1)+(-2)=-1 \\
\mathbf F(1,3)&=5\,i-j \\
P(-1,-2)&=(-2)-(-2)=0 \\
Q(-1,-2)&=(-1)+(-2)=-3 \\
\mathbf F(-1,-2)&=-3\,j \\
P(-1,3)&=(3)-(-2)=5 \\
Q(-1,3)&=(-1)+(-2)=-3 \\
\mathbf F(-1,3)&=5\,i-3\,j
\end{aligned}
$$

The first component gives the horizontal displacement and the second gives the vertical displacement. Place each tail at its labeled point. A zero component gives no displacement along that axis; a zero vector stays at its tail.

$$
\mathbf F(x,y)=\left(y+1\right)\,i+\left(x+1\right)\,j
$$

at $A=(-2,-1)$, $B=(1,2)$, $C=(1,1)$? All diagrams use one unit per grid interval.

Arrowhead from $A$: $(${{A x-coordinate}}$,\,${{A y-coordinate}}$)$

Arrowhead from $B$: $(${{B x-coordinate}}$,\,${{B y-coordinate}}$)$

Arrowhead from $C$: $(${{C x-coordinate}}$,\,${{C y-coordinate}}$)$
question.:question/worked-solution:
Write $\mathbf F=P\,i+Q\,j$. Substitute into each component, then combine the results:

$$
\begin{aligned}
P(-2,-1)&=(-1)-(-1)=0 \\
Q(-2,-1)&=(-2)+(1)=-1 \\
\mathbf F(-2,-1)&=-j \\
P(1,2)&=(2)-(-1)=3 \\
Q(1,2)&=(1)+(1)=2 \\

P(1,1)&=(1)-(-1)=2 \\
Q(1,1)&=(1)+(1)=2 \\
\mathbf F(1,1)&=2\,i+2\,j
\end{aligned}
$$

The first component gives the horizontal displacement and the second gives the vertical displacement. Place each tail at its labeled point. A zero component gives no displacement along that axis; a zero vector stays at its tail.

Add each displacement to its tail to find the arrowhead:

$$
\begin{aligned}
A+\mathbf F(A)&=(-2+(0),-1+(-1))=(-2,-2) \\
B+\mathbf F(B)&=(1+(3),2+(2))=(4,4) \\
C+\mathbf F(C)&=(1+(2),1+(2))=(3,3)
\end{aligned}
$$

question.:question/problem:

Write $\mathbf F=P\,i+Q\,j$. Substitute into each component, then combine the results:
